name: Toolboxes
summary: Foundry Toolbox versioned MCP endpoint consumed by a BYOM-routed Prompt Agent via MCPTool.
description: Verified live 2026-07-15 with azure-ai-projects 2.3.0: create a Toolbox version with `project.toolboxes.create_version(tools=[ToolboxSearchPreviewToolboxTool()])` and hand the agent an `MCPTool` pointed at `{project_endpoint}/toolboxes/{name}/versions/{v}/mcp?api-version=v1` (with an AAD bearer). The BYOM-prefixed Prompt Agent successfully invokes the toolbox's `tool_search` MCP tool — no `toolbox_search_preview` rejection.
notes: Historical note: SDK 2.2.0 exposed a `ToolboxSearchPreviewTool` you could attach directly to an agent; that path IS rejected under BYOM ('The following tools are not supported with BYO model: toolbox_search_preview'). The 2.3.0 pattern wraps the toolbox behind MCP, and MCP is BYOM-supported, so the whole flow works. Reference sample: https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-python/blob/main/sdk/ai/azure-ai-projects/samples/agents/tools/sample_agent_toolbox_skill.py
